messages:
elaine: FYI support escalated a customer p95/p99 latency spike after the recent continuous-batcher tweak. acme-inc reports p99 ~2400ms on /v1/generate for short prompts (avg 12 tokens). Tenant=acme-inc, model=redwood-v0.9, region=us-west-2. trace: https://traces.internal/acme/xyz123

chris: OK grabbing logs and config. which rollout did we push? batcher service change yesterday?

elaine: yep small change to default hold_window_ms and grace_window to improve throughput on larger prompts. I have the canary conf:
```
continuous_batcher:
  max_batch_size: 16
  hold_window_ms: 12
  grace_window_ms: 3
  coalesce: true
```

sanjay: thanks. that hold_window looks slightly higher than previous (was 6ms). small/short inputs pay the penalty — they sit waiting for coalescing and create tail latency. seeing p95 ~300-400ms and p99 ~2.4s matches short requests queuing until batch fills.

lisa: can we repro in staging quickly? i can run a small hammer script that sends 10rps with 8-16 token prompts.

chris: pls include request headers we see from prod (Authorization omitted). also capture LD/rollout id and exact model hash.

elaine: rollout id roll/2026-03-15/cont-batcher-v2, model hash a1b2c3. sample request body: `{"input": "Summarize: hi"}`

sanjay: quick repro curl (staging endpoint):
```bash
for i in {1..200}; do
  curl -sS -X POST https://staging-api.internal/v1/generate -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"redwood-v0.9","input":"short prompt ${i}"}' &
done
wait
```
this should surface long tails when hold_window is too large.

lisa: running now, attaching p95/p99 from prometheus. p95=380ms, p99=2100ms on staging with same conf. repro confirmed.

chris: thanks. immediate mitigation options: 1) revert hold_window to 6ms globally, 2) lower canary % and rollback, 3) change to adaptive hold that shortest path for <32 token requests. quick hotfix is to reduce hold_window for tenant acme-inc via per-tenant override.

elaine: acme asks for mitigation now. i've got a support playbook step: apply per-tenant override then notify customer. can we do a safe push?

sanjay: I can patch the override: set `hold_window_ms: 5`, `max_batch_size: 8`, `grace_window_ms: 2` for tenant acme-inc on their dedicated pool. That should drop p99 to ~400-500ms.

chris: before we push, add a CI check to ensure no regression for larger prompts (>512 tokens). ci-bot: can you run perf smoke with mixed prompt sizes after config change? @ci-bot

ci-bot: Running perf-smoke-mixed on canary pool; will post results in 10m.

lisa: customer-facing message ready: "we've applied a temporary per-tenant update to reduce inferred wait time for short prompts while we tune the continuous-batcher rollout. Expect improvement in ~5-10 minutes." :thumbsup:

elaine: rolling override to acme-inc now (10% traffic route to override first).

sanjay: override applied to 10% canary. monitoring.

(5m later)

lisa: canary metrics: acme p95 down to 260ms, p99 down to 480ms on canary route. overall pool unaffected for large prompts.

chris: CI results: perf smoke shows no regression for >512 tokens (latency within 2% baseline). safe to increase rollout.

elaine: increasing override to 100% for acme-inc. sending update to customer.

support-bot: Notified customer/contact: acme-support@acme.inc — message sent and ticket updated #INC-4521.

chris: follow-ups: 1) short-term config baseline revert for all-hosted by end of day, 2) implement adaptive hold_window based on token length distribution (tracking ticket ENG-6231), 3) postmortem with timeline + telemetry analysis.

sanjay: I'll open PR for adaptive hold prototype + perf tests. also adding alert rule for p99 > 1s on small-prompt percentile bucket.

lisa: logging notes for postmortem: capture batch sizes distribution + time-in-queue histogram; currently we only have percentiles. need raw histograms to correlate hold window waits to p99.

elaine: thanks team. acme confirmed improvements. closing escalation once postmortem and code change scheduled.

chris: 👍 will add runbook entry to prevent future accidental raise of hold_window without a small-prompt impact check.

support-bot: Incident ticket transitioned to "Mitigated".

sanjay: copying repro artifacts into /internal/triage/1719801234-mini-holdback for later.

lisa: marking this thread for follow-up sync tomorrow.
